articles.summary: SAN JOSE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / October 26, 2026 / Avidbank Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVBH) (the "Company" or "Avidbank Holdings"), the holding company for Avidbank, a California state-chartered bank (the "Bank"), announced net income for the third quarter of 2026 of $10.2 million, or $0.94 per diluted share, compared to net income of $7.6 million, or $0.71 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026 and a net loss of $37.7 million, or $4.12 loss per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Period-end loans, net of deferred fees, increased $58.4 million, or 10% annualized, from June 30, 2026 and $323.9 million, or 17%, from September 30, 2025. Average deposits increased $283.8 million, or 51% annualized, from the second quarter of 2026 and $449.9 million, or 22%, from the third quarter of 2025. articles.summary: SAN JOSE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / October 7, 2026 / Avidbank Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVBH) ("Avidbank Holdings") announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 earnings results on Monday, October 26, 2026, after the market closes. Upon release, investors may access a copy of the earnings results on the Avidbank website at www.avidbank.com under About Us, Investor Relations. Avidbank Holdings will host a conference call on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (EDT) / 8:00 a.m. (PDT) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. Investors may call in by dialing (833) 461-5787 within the US and +1 (585) 542-9983 for all other locations. The conference ID number is 530 848 984. Participants may also pre-register for the conference by navigating to https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/530848984 .
